AEK-973.description:
An improved variant of the AEK-973 which features a new trigger mechanism and an extended padded retractable stock.
Chambered in the powerful 7.62x39mm cartridge while retaining a high fire rate, balanced recoil and high damage.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
AEK-973.name: AEK-973

PKP-B.description:
A lighter bullpup variant of the PKP machine gun.
Features two grips where the primary one is upfront for handheld, while the back grip is typically used while prone.
Lighter, with a decent fire rate, great close-up damage but falls short at range and harder to reload.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
PKP-B.name: PKP-B

EF88.description:
The 'Enhanced F88' is an Nomenslandian adopted variant of the UAR. It is a lighter weighing upgrade of the F88.
High fire rate with high damage up close while remaining reliable for ranged combat.

Model submitted by Rialag.
EF88.name: EF88

CAN CANNON.description:
An AR-15 with a custom upper receiver and barrel assembly that allows it to use blank-firing cartridges to launch cans.

Pathetically low velocity, but somehow packed with super armor piercing cans that can punch through walls and people alike.
CAN CANNON.name: CAN CANNON

HK337.description:
A shortened variant of the Eisenmarkian M38A5 chambered in the .300 BLK round. While atypical, it never reached mass production by Eisenmark.
Has great close range performance with damage and firerate, but falls short due to its much slower velocity and range effectiveness.

Model submitted by Rialag.
HK337.name: HK337

SUGAR WEASEL.description:
A Grand Federation Rifle chambered in 5.56x45mm, built on an upgraded AR-15 platform. Improved customization and controllable rate of fire.

Model submitted by Rialag & Vic.
SUGAR WEASEL.name: SUGAR WEASEL

C8NLD.description:
An adaptation of the C8 IUR with a distinct stock and handguard design.

Model submitted by Rialag.
C8NLD.name: C8NLD

AUG A3.description:
A further revision of the UAR platform with additional minor revisions. Jack of all trades of the UAR family, but has noticeable horizontal recoil.

Model submitted by Rialag.
AUG A3.name: AUG A3

MINI FIX.description:
A miniaturized version of The Fix - even lighter, smaller, and chambered for .300 Blackout or 5.56x45mm NATO.

Incredibly lightweight and fast firing with a unique bolt that allows it to be operated while aiming through scopes.

Model submitted by Vic
MINI FIX.name: MINI FIX

M4A1.description:
An upgraded and modernized version of the M4 carbine with the SOPMOD I accessory kit installed.
Fully automatic trigger group with very stable firing characteristics, strong CQB performance, and weaker ranged performance.

Model submitted by Rialag.
M4A1.name: M4A1

G36K.description: A slightly shortened carbine variant of the Eisenmark STG-91 rifle, featuring a shorter handguard and barrel. Featuring higher close quarters performance but with a shallow damage slope.
G36K.name: G36K

AKU12.description:
A speculative concept carbine based on the original AK-12 pre-production variant, with elements clearly inspired by the AKS-74U 'Krinkov' PDW.

Strong performance in CQC with good handling, but relatively poor damage at longer ranges.

Model submitted by Rialag
AKU12.name: AKU12
